title: 多项业务相互带动，怎样讲清资源投入的重点？
topic: 迪士尼季度策略：让内容、平台和体验互相带动

source.title: Disney Q3 FY26 Earnings: Commentary from CEO Josh D’Amaro | The Walt Disney Company

source.context: 迪士尼季度策略：让内容、平台和体验互相带动
paragraphs: “This success reflects our continued execution across three strategic priorities: First, investing in creative excellence and world-class IP. Second, leveraging technology to accelerate growth and drive returns. And third, deepening our direct relationships with fans by creating a more connected Disney experience.” he said. “Anchoring these strategic priorities is our One Disney operating model, which will allow us to fully capture the value of our portfolio for both fans and shareholders.”

“Now, that’s the Disney flywheel in action,” he said. “One powerful and enduring story, told across theaters, streaming, retail, and physical experiences. That integration creates a structure no one else has been able to replicate.”

“This efficiency, it matters financially, too,” he said. “When our teams work smarter, we can serve more people across our parks and digital platforms and do it more cost-effectively. That frees up capital to reinvest aggressively in what drives long-term value: new content and next-generation guest experiences, as well as technology infrastructure that keeps Disney at the forefront of entertainment.”
translations: “这一表现反映了我们持续推进三项战略重点：第一，投资于卓越创意和世界级知识产权；第二，借助技术加速增长、提升回报；第三，通过打造更连贯的 Disney 体验，加深与粉丝的直接联系。”他说。“One Disney”运营模式是这些重点的基础，帮助公司为粉丝和股东充分释放业务组合的价值。
他说：“这就是 Disney 飞轮的运作方式：一个强大而持久的故事，通过影院、流媒体、零售和线下体验触达粉丝。这种整合形成了别人难以复制的结构。”
他说：“效率在财务上也很重要。团队更高效地协作，我们就能以更低成本服务更多乐园和数字平台用户。这能释放资金，让我们继续投入真正推动长期价值的领域：新内容、下一代游客体验，以及让迪士尼继续站在娱乐行业前沿的技术基础设施。”
fullTextParagraphs: The Walt Disney Company reported its third-quarter earnings on Wednesday (available here), with CEO Josh D’Amaro addressing investors on the results and his first five months in the role.

“During my first five months as CEO, I’ve been focused on ensuring that we execute as one company around a unified strategy,” D’Amaro said on the earnings call. “And what we’re seeing this quarter is proof that coordinating our franchises, sharing data and technology, and building seamless fan experiences works.”
He noted that Disney’s “fundamental advantage is the depth of our fan relationships, and that translates directly to durable financial returns.”

D’Amaro mentioned that “we find ourselves in an environment where consumers have more options than ever for their time,” but that the company’s results show that “they keep choosing to spend their time with Disney.”

“This success reflects our continued execution across three strategic priorities: First, investing in creative excellence and world-class IP. Second, leveraging technology to accelerate growth and drive returns. And third, deepening our direct relationships with fans by creating a more connected Disney experience.” he said. “Anchoring these strategic priorities is our One Disney operating model, which will allow us to fully capture the value of our portfolio for both fans and shareholders.”

Before walking investors through the quarter’s performance, D’Amaro paused to highlight a few examples that “demonstrate how the strength of our consumer connections and the power of our IP are expanding our reach and our relevance.”
Growing global guests 4% year-over-year, with particular strength at Walt Disney World, while the company also benefitted from additional capacity at Disney Cruise Line.
The strength of our franchise IP via the financial and cultural impact of Toy Story 5, which recently surpassed $1 billion at the global box office.

And the unique passion of sports fandom drove over 100% growth in NBA Finals and NHL postseason viewership across ESPN and ABC versus the prior season*¹, making this the most viewed fiscal Q3 across ESPN, ESPN2, and ESPN on ABC since 2016.
Starting with Disney Experiences, D’Amaro said that Disney is “proud of the growth that we’ve had this year, and we’re investing to sustain that growth.”

“The pipeline includes major attractions at every site, including Villains Land in Orlando and the Avengers Campus expansion in Anaheim, amongst others in the U.S., and our previously announced cruise ship expansion,” he said.

“At our studios, the blockbuster success of the latest Toy Story installment shows exactly why Disney is different from the competition, and how our stories translate into recurring earnings power,” D’Amaro said.

He noted that the five Toy Story films have delivered more than $4 billion at the global box office and over 2 billion hours streamed on Disney+. Across all retailers, the franchise generates more than $1 billion in annual global retail sales *² and reaches fans at every Disney park and cruise ship — spanning four immersive lands, 19 attractions, and two hotels.

“Now, that’s the Disney flywheel in action,” he said. “One powerful and enduring story, told across theaters, streaming, retail, and physical experiences. That integration creates a structure no one else has been able to replicate.”

He added that “even when our franchise films don’t meet our box office expectations, as with The Mandalorian and Grogu and the live-action Moana, our investments in these core properties fuel other parts of our company.” The Mandalorian and Grogu, for instance, drove healthy growth in Star Wars retail sales, drew guests to the updated Millennium Falcon attraction at Disneyland and Walt Disney World, and led to significant engagement in gaming.
As for the live-action Moana, D’Amaro said it’s expected to be a strong performer on Disney+, building on the success of the original — one of the most-streamed films of all time.*³
D’Amaro said “the appeal of our IP across multiple consumer touchpoints is central to our strategy, and Disney+ is the digital centerpiece for that.”
During the quarter, he noted, “we passed an important milestone in app unification, allowing Hulu standalone and bundle subscribers to link profiles and manage subscriptions on Disney+.”
Still, he acknowledged the company has “work to do scaling Disney+ outside the U.S., and we’re focused on driving growth and returns over the long term in under-monetized markets.”
“Our strategy is clear,” D’Amaro added. “Leverage regional relationships and bring regional content onto Disney+ at scale. And that’s how we will grow internationally.”

He explained that Disney’s long-term streaming strategy rests on two pillars: “make the core streaming experience the best in the marketplace and connect our businesses into a single digital ecosystem.”

“Beyond our films and series, Disney+ will continue to evolve, bringing together games, merchandise, and other experiences, while offering increased personalization, exclusivity, and benefits for subscribers,” he said. “All of this is designed to deepen engagement, improve the value proposition, lower churn, and – most importantly – increase lifetime fan value. We expect to introduce elements of this expanded ecosystem beginning in Spring of 2027.”
D’Amaro concluded by saying that “Disney+ provides the global reach to develop new fans and the consumer data to drive personalization, which are both core to our long-term strategy.”
That same strategy extends to sports, where, according to D’Amaro, “ESPN gives us another powerful way to deepen our relationship with fans.”
As Disney+ evolves, he added, “we’ll continue to bring select premium sports events to the platform.”

“At the same time, ESPN remains the primary destination for daily sports content,” he said. “Live sports aren’t just a viewership play; they’re a fan engagement and ecosystem play. When a sports fan engages with ESPN, Disney+, or our parks, their lifetime value increases.”
Before wrapping the call, D’Amaro turned to the emerging technology underpinning all of this work.

“Our company was founded on the convergence of creativity and breakthrough technology – and continuing that tradition is a priority for me and this leadership team,” he said. “That’s why we’re leveraging AI to bring the most innovative tools to our storytellers. As I’ve said before, AI isn’t simply about efficiency – it’s about enhancing a creative process that will always be human-centered, artist-driven, and creator-led.”

He continued, “AI lets us work faster and smarter, particularly in areas of pre- and post-production. Our teams can personalize content and experiences for fans around the world at scale. And we are doing all of this while keeping human creativity at the center. AI amplifies what our storytellers can do – it doesn’t replace them.”

“This efficiency, it matters financially, too,” he said. “When our teams work smarter, we can serve more people across our parks and digital platforms and do it more cost-effectively. That frees up capital to reinvest aggressively in what drives long-term value: new content and next-generation guest experiences, as well as technology infrastructure that keeps Disney at the forefront of entertainment.”
Wrapping up his commentary, D’Amaro said that “there is clarity of purpose inside this company right now.”

“We know what Disney is: a storyteller with an unmatched ability to reach fans across every format and every geography. We know how technology amplifies that power. And we know that when we operate in an integrated fashion with speed, discipline, and efficiency, we can create long-term shareholder value,” he said concluding the call.
¹ Includes viewership of TNT sports coverage of the Stanley Cup Finals in 2025
² Includes third party retail sales

The information above should be read together with Disney’s Q3 FY26 earnings release, Form 10-Q and earnings webcast (available here), which discuss additional information, including additional challenges and risks the company’s businesses face and additional information about Q3 FY26 performance.

Any information that is not historical in nature is subject to change. These statements are made on the basis of management’s views and assumptions regarding future events and business performance as of the time the statements are made. Actual results may differ materially from those expressed or implied. Such differences may result from actions taken by the company, including our business decisions and execution of our business plans, as well as from developments beyond the company’s control, including: the occurrence of subsequent events; domestic and global economic, geopolitical and operating conditions; competitive conditions; consumer preferences; and legal and regulatory developments.

Additional factors are set forth in the company’s most recent Annual Report on Form 10-K, including under the captions “Risk Factors,” “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations,” and “Business,” subsequent quarterly reports on Form 10-Q, including under the captions “Risk Factors” and “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations,” and subsequent filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

The terms “company,” “Disney,” “we,” and “our” are used in this communication to refer collectively to the parent company and the subsidiaries through which our various businesses are actually conducted.

notes.explain: priority 表示要优先安排资源和精力的方向。
notes.example: The business set three strategic priorities for the next year.

notes.phrase: One powerful and enduring story, told across theaters, streaming, retail, and physical experiences.
notes.meaning: 一个强大而持久的故事，通过影院、流媒体、零售和线下体验触达粉丝。
notes.explain: across 列出内容触达受众的多个渠道。
notes.example: The campaign reached customers across email, stores, and events.

notes.phrase: That frees up capital to reinvest aggressively in what drives long-term value
notes.meaning: 这能释放资金，让公司继续投入真正推动长期价值的领域
notes.explain: free up capital 表示腾出资金；reinvest in 表示再投入。
notes.example: The cost reduction freed up capital to reinvest in customer support.

scenario.title: 年度经营会：解释内容、平台和线下体验的投入顺序
english: A media company has several projects competing for the same budget: new content, platform improvements, and live experiences.
Projects can support one another, but leaders need a clear reason for prioritizing each investment.
Explain the strategic priorities and how the team will evaluate long-term value.
chinese: 一家媒体公司有多个项目争夺同一笔预算：新内容、平台改进和线下体验。
这些项目可以相互支持，但管理层需要清楚的优先依据。
请说明战略重点，以及团队如何评估长期价值。

firstAttempt.prompt: 请用英语向团队说明三类投入怎样共同支持业务增长，并讲清如何判断长期价值。
firstAttempt.sample: Our priorities are to invest in distinctive content, use technology to improve the platform, and deepen direct relationships with fans. These projects can support one another across streaming, retail, and live experiences. We’ll assess each investment by its contribution to fan engagement, churn reduction, and lifetime fan value.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先说明投入重点，再解释项目间的业务联系和评估依据。

taskPhrases.collocation: state a small set of business priorities
taskPhrases.example: Our priorities are to invest in new content and improve the streaming experience.
taskPhrases.translation: 我们的优先事项是投资新内容并改善流媒体体验。

taskPhrases.word: These projects support one another across…
taskPhrases.meaning: 这些项目在……之间相互支持
taskPhrases.collocation: explain how related investments work together
taskPhrases.example: These projects support one another across streaming, retail, and live events.
taskPhrases.translation: 这些项目在流媒体、零售和现场活动之间相互支持。

taskPhrases.meaning: 我们会根据……评估每项投入
taskPhrases.example: We’ll assess each investment by its contribution to fan engagement, reduced churn, and lifetime fan value.
taskPhrases.translation: 我们会根据每项投入对粉丝互动、降低流失率和粉丝终身价值的贡献进行评估。

words.example: The team aligned its work with three strategic priorities.
words.translation: 团队的工作与三项战略重点保持一致。
words.note: 指公司在一段时间内优先推动的业务方向。

words.meaning: 系列品牌；知识产权系列
words.example: The franchise supports stories across several formats.
words.translation: 这一系列品牌支持多种形式的故事内容。
words.note: 在媒体行业中常指可跨影视、商品和体验开发的系列内容。

words.example: The company reinvested savings in new content.
words.translation: 公司把节省下来的资金重新投入新内容。
words.note: 把节省或赚取的资源再次投入业务。

structure.original: That integration creates a structure no one else has been able to replicate.
analysis: that 指前文提到的跨影院、流媒体、零售和线下体验的整合。
has been able to 表示到目前为止具备某种能力。
structure.transfer: The connected account system creates a customer experience competitors have not been able to replicate.

rewrite.bad: We should invest in content, technology, and experiences because all are important.
rewrite.good: Our priorities are to invest in distinctive content, use technology to improve the platform, and deepen direct relationships with fans. These projects can support one another across streaming, retail, and live experiences. We’ll assess each investment by its contribution to engagement, recurring revenue, and long-term customer value.
rewrite.translation: 我们的优先事项是投资有特色的内容、用技术改善平台，并加深与粉丝的直接关系。这些项目能在流媒体、零售和线下体验之间互相支持。我们会根据每项投入对用户互动、经常性收入和长期客户价值的贡献来评估。
rewrite.pattern: Our priorities are to [A], [B], and [C]. These projects support one another across [channels]. We’ll assess each by [business value].

cloze.prompt: Our strategic ______ are to invest in content and technology.
cloze.why: strategic priorities 指公司优先推动的业务方向。

cloze.prompt: The projects support one another ______ streaming and live experiences.
cloze.why: across 表示横跨多个渠道或业务。

cloze.prompt: We’ll ______ each investment by its contribution to fan engagement, reduced churn, and lifetime fan value.
cloze.why: assess each investment by... 用于说明评估投入的依据。

dictation.text: Our strategy is clear: leverage regional relationships and bring regional content onto Disney+ at scale.
dictation.why: leverage regional relationships 指利用当地合作关系；at scale 表示大规模推广。

dictation.text: That frees up capital to reinvest in what drives long-term value.
dictation.why: 听清 frees up capital 与 reinvest 的先后关系。

translationPractice.prompt: 我们的优先事项是投资新内容并改善流媒体体验。
translationPractice.answer: Our priorities are to invest in new content and improve the streaming experience.
translationPractice.why: 先归纳有限且清楚的战略重点。

translationPractice.prompt: 这些项目在流媒体、零售和现场活动之间相互支持。
translationPractice.answer: These projects support one another across streaming, retail, and live events.
translationPractice.why: 说明一个系列内容如何跨渠道触达粉丝。

translationPractice.prompt: 我们会根据每项投入对粉丝互动、降低流失率和粉丝终身价值的贡献进行评估。
translationPractice.answer: We’ll assess each investment by its contribution to fan engagement, reduced churn, and lifetime fan value.
translationPractice.why: 使用原文提到的互动、流失率和粉丝终身价值，说明评估依据。

choice.prompt: 一项视频平台计划同时增加新剧预算、改进推荐系统并举办线下粉丝活动。怎样说明资源安排更有说服力？
options: We should fund all three because they are exciting.
State the priorities, explain how the three investments support one another, and compare their expected contribution to engagement and long-term value.
Choose the project with the most internal support.
choice.why: 说明不同投入怎样组成业务路径，并给出比较优先级的标准。

output.prompt: 公司要在客服自动化、知识库改版和用户教育活动之间分配预算。请说明重点及投入评估依据。
output.sample: Our priorities are to reduce repeated support requests, make answers easier to find, and help customers use the product well. These projects support one another across the help center, in-product guidance, and customer support. We’ll assess each investment by its effect on resolution time, repeat contacts, and long-term retention.
check: 列出明确的业务优先项
解释项目如何相互支持
说明怎样评估投入价值
